io: Make sure the game is closed and its folder is not read-only. If that does not help, collect the logs under Help.
json: The manager rewrites the file on the next save. If it keeps happening, collect the logs under Help.
http: Check your connection and try again in a minute. The installed modpack keeps working.
client_not_found: Open Settings and pick the folder where «Мир танков» is installed (the one with Tanki.exe).
client_running: Quit the game completely (not just the battle), then press the button again.
not_installed: Install the modpack from the home page first.
unknown_component: The catalogue is out of date: press «Check now» on the home page to load a new one.
required_component: The other components need it, so it cannot be switched off.
profile_limit: Delete a profile you no longer need and save again.
profile_name: The name cannot be empty or longer than 40 characters.
profile_missing: The profile list was refreshed: pick the profile again.
profile_code: A profile code starts with TM1. — copy all of it.
checksum_mismatch: This happens when the connection drops or an antivirus interferes. Run the install again.
release_unavailable: The release for your game version is still being prepared. The manager will tell you when it is out.
invalid_path: Pick the game's root folder, the one with Tanki.exe.
autostart: Windows did not allow the autostart change. Try again or enable it in Task Manager.
busy: Another operation is running, such as a background update. It takes less than a minute.
client_unsupported: Install «Мир танков» through Lesta Game Center and select that client in Settings.
signature_invalid: The files may have been tampered with on the way. Nothing was installed: try later or download the manager from the site again.
untrusted_host: The manager downloads only from triotmetki.ru and the official pages of the library authors.
disk_full: Clear the game cache in Settings or delete files you do not need, then try again.
file_locked: Close the game and Lesta Game Center, add the game folder to your antivirus exclusions and try again.
access_denied: Clear the read-only flag on the game folder, allow the manager in Controlled folder access or your antivirus, or run the manager as an administrator.
rollback_failed: Close the game and antivirus scans of the game folder, then reinstall the modpack from Home. The previous files are kept next to the new ones with the .otm-old ending.
nothing_to_restore: Open Home and install the modpack again: your settings stay.
set_limit: You can keep up to 12 sets.
set_name: The name cannot be empty or longer than 40 characters.
set_missing: The set list was refreshed: pick the set again.
set_code: A set code starts with TS1., a set file ends in .tmset.
offline: Check your connection. The installed modpack keeps working.
not_linked: Enter a binding code from the site in the “Sync through the site” card, or bind the mod in the game.
link_revoked: The device was unlinked on the site. Get a new code in your account and link the manager again.
link_code: A code works for 10 minutes and only once. Get a new code on the site and enter it in full.
rate_limited: The server limits how often you can ask. Try again in a few minutes.
sync_unavailable: Your sets and profiles stay on this PC. Update the manager when a new version comes out.
report_expired: Close the report window and open it again — the logs will be collected anew.
site_offline: Check your connection and try again. Everything is saved on this PC — nothing is lost.
contract: Update the manager under Settings → About. If that does not help, collect the logs under Help.
unknown: Try again. If the error stays, collect the logs under Help and send them to us.
